quest.title: Abyss Mage
quest.description: You used the Holy Lyre der Himmel to summon Stormterror, only to be prevented from saving it due to the interference of the Abyss Order. But you haven't given up yet — and Diluc has been able to swiftly obtain a new lead...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Mora x10725, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x2

chapter.title: Song of the Dragon and Freedom

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: The Abyss Order... Enemies of the human race. Even the underground networks rarely come across any information on them.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: With that said, it was a bit of a hassle, but I managed to dig up a few clues.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Really? That quickly? You really are well connected, Master Diluc.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, Mr. Big Anemo God Barbatos — why exactly do you need the help of mere humans...?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ahh... How do I put it...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: "The Seven" as people now know them, were once known as "The Seven Archons."

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Each archon presides over their own part of Teyvat. That is the role the archons play.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Only in performing this duty can we attain power, but I don't like the idea of "ruling" Mondstadt — and I don't feel Mondstadt would really like it either.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: "Go forth and establish a city of freedom without rule." We have not forgotten Barbatos' wish for Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe someone got a little too free and is just too lazy to care...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ahh... However it may have come to be... I haven't been back to Mondstadt for an extended period of time.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Without a doubt, I am now the weakest archon among The Seven!

choices.text: And yet you sound almost proud...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Aww, you flatter me.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Oh, such a humble god... Is it a blessing, or a curse?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: But we digress. Let's get back to the topic at hand: the common enemy of all mankind.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: We have tracked the <color=#00E1FFFF>Abyss Mage</color> to the vicinity of the <color=#00E1FFFF>winery</color>.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I cannot stress enough how important it is to not let it escape.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's hunt it down!

choices.text: Guess that's why you're god to the City of Freedom...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: After the Abyss Mage was defeated, a certain energy dispersed from its body...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It seems that energy was being used to cut off the connection between me and Dvalin.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But Jean and Master Diluc are no doubt aware of it.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: After Dvalin woke up, he took the ancient ruins as his lair.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: As it was with the storms that previously cut Mondstadt off from the outside world, the entrance to the ruins is also sealed by a special barrier.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But now, as the energy dispersed from the Abyss Mage, I was able to read the rhythmic flow of how the barrier's magic was woven.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I must admit, it sounds even more horrendous than a chorus of hilichurls, but...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: ...It should be enough to let us break through the storm barrier and reach <color=#00E1FFFF>Stormterror's Lair</color>.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Which means we're going to confront Dvalin?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I'm fine with that... Jean is the one who wishes to avoid any direct confrontation.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: No. When there are no other options left, it is my responsibility to alter our course of action.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: If slaying him is our only choice, I will gladly become the knight that leads the charge.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Fortunately, we have yet to need to go that far.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: By that, you mean...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I mean that the Holy Lyre is not our trump card.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: #Our real trump card? {NICKNAME} of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Is it because I purified the Teardrop Crystal?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Agreed.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: The impurities in the tears, and the curse that binds Dvalin belong to the same maleficent power.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Which means...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You Tone-Deaf Bard, don't you see how crazy this is?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You've seen what Dvalin is like when he's ticked off! {NICKNAME} will be swallowed whole before {M#he}{F#she} even gets to lift a finger!

choices.text: Weren't we just talking about how I can fight?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: ...Hey.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Nice plan. Worth a shot.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I am with you, Honorary Knight!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ho~! So we just need to fight monsters from the abyss... and a dragon! No pressure or anything.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Humans aren't without their strengths. Let's go.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: And so...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: The epic actions of brave heroes finally leads to this eleventh hour.

choices.text: This battle... it's going to take everything everyone's got.
Is it because I can fight?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Well, you could say that... You're definitely a force to be reckoned with.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But you have a much more precious forte.

choices.text: I think I've heard people talking about it in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Of course. I believe the people of Mondstadt all know of it.
